title: Report routed lengths of the xSignals in each class
summary: Walks the board's xSignal classes with a class iterator and reports each member pin pair's node count and total, routed and unrouted length from the pin pair manager; also creates an xSignal and assigns it to a class.
phrasings: get xSignal lengths on a board
list pin pairs in each xSignal class
measure routed and unrouted length of a signal
create an xSignal between two pins
